PU-PokeballMachine.note: Custom sheet: lab starter machine (Map050 EV19). 96x128 frame, content 43x55 post-downscale — requires the 64x64 large-prop sprite class (slice-1 interior expansion); fails the standard 32x32 path by design. Multi-STATE: RMXP animates it with code-41 Change Graphic steps that keep the sheet and move only (direction, pattern), so every non-empty grid cell is emitted as its own graphics-info + gfx id (see 'states'); the idle cell (2,0) keeps the bare constant. sprite_pass cross-checks these against the real PNG's non-empty cells and fails loud on drift
